landmarks.name: Belgrade Fortress
landmarks.writeup: Historic fortress overlooking the confluence of the River Sava and Danube, symbolizing Belgrade's strategic importance.

landmarks.name: Studenica Monastery
landmarks.writeup: A 12th-century Serbian Orthodox monastery, renowned for its medieval frescoes and cultural significance.

landmarks.name: nerdap National Park
landmarks.writeup: Home to the Iron Gates gorge on the Danube, featuring diverse wildlife and archaeological sites.

cultural_events.name: EXIT Festival
cultural_events.writeup: One of Europe's largest music festivals held annually in Novi Sad, attracting international artists and visitors.

cultural_events.name: Guna Trumpet Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional brass band festival celebrating Serbian folk music and culture in the town of Guna.

food_writeup: Serbian cuisine features grilled meats, fresh bread, cheeses, and dishes like nevapi and sarma, reflecting Balkan and Mediterranean influences.
brief_history: Serbia has a rich history dating back to the medieval Serbian Kingdom, Ottoman rule, and later as part of Yugoslavia before regaining independence in the 2000s.
current_conflicts: Serbia faces ongoing diplomatic tensions related to Kosovo's status, with unresolved political disputes but no active armed conflict.
